title: State v. Nyema (N.J. 2022)
key_points: Holding: A vague description (race and gender of suspects, without more) did not provide reasonable suspicion to stop a vehicle.
officer_notes: Scenario: After a robbery, dispatch reports two Black men fled. You stop the first car you see with two Black male occupants.
Takeaway: Stops based on a description need more than race and gender; look for clothing, vehicle, direction, timing and other details.
